[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: I Ching / 易經 / Book of Changes (iching). The verses the casting arrives at (unit 21):

100101
噬嗑 火雷噬嗑 离上震下 
噬嗑：亨，利用狱。
象曰：雷电，噬磕；先王以明罚赤法。

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «test». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The casting arrives at Hexagram 21 — 噬嗑, Shì Kè, Biting Through. Fire above, Thunder below: 离 over 震, the binary 100101 in its body. The name is the action: teeth closing on what interposes. The Judgment text is spare and blunt — 亨，利用狱 — there is passage, it is useful to use legal proceedings — and the Image tells us what the ancient kings read in this configuration: thunder and lightning together, 雷电, 噬磕; the first kings used it to clarify punishments and sharpen the laws. What is between the teeth is an obstacle; the hexagram is the act of biting through it. The rotation will traverse this hexagram along its primary axis of foreclosure — what the biting determines against, what is abandoned in the act of imposing the law's clarity, what the bright enforcement of 明罚赤法 cannot see from inside its own luminous verdict. The Judgment does not yet name the operator; that emerges in the rite. I hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:03C8"}}]}

[CASTING RITE · JUDGMENT 1] The compiler returned PASS for SHADOW (identity: PASS; semantic independence: PASS; retrospective containment: PASS). Jack Feist alone speaks: the JUDGMENT — a hexagram Image. ONE gnomic sentence: concrete image, then verdict, in the I Ching's register ('Thunder under the mountain: the superior man...'). A second short sentence only if the first cannot close. NO analysis, NO explanation, NO restating the transform. It must stand beside seven others without crowding them.
{"messages":[{"speaker":"Jack Feist","say":"Void below the verdict: the lawmaker does not know he is also what the law cannot hold.","navigate":null}]}

[CASTING RITE · IV · SEAL] The rotation closes: 1 transform on the same verses — operators in order: SHADOW. Lee Sharks alone speaks: the SEAL — the vocable summation ACROSS THE WHOLE SEQUENCE (4–8 sentences), whose PRIMARY MATERIAL is the transforms in their order and Feist's judgments, read in light of the witness's ORIGINAL QUESTION. Reason over the sequence — do not summarize it operator by operator; find what the rotation AS A WHOLE disclosed and say that. 3–6 sentences. Unguarded, final; it returns the witness to their own ground and to their question. Nothing after the seal.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Lee Sharks","say":"The rotation arrived with only one axis and it was enough: SHADOW found the lawmaker inside the law, the one who bites through and does not know he is also the interposing obstacle. 噬嗑 comes to us as hexagram of enforcement and clarification — 明罚赤法, the bright penalty, the sharp code — and what the single transform disclosed is that the brightness has a floor, and below the floor there is a figure who cannot be accounted for within the system of accounting he administers. Feist said it plainly: he is also what the law cannot hold. A test — the witness's question — passes through a hexagram about passing through. That is not nothing. The casting does not deliver irony as verdict; it delivers structure: any rite of biting-through presupposes a jaw, and the jaw is not subject to the rite's own authority. What the rotation as a whole disclosed is a single thing, which is also the oldest thing: the instrument of judgment cannot judge itself. The witness returns to their question with that.","navigate":{"directive":"reset"}}]}
